scoring_justification: Cannot recompute DFT phonon shifts in verifier; compare agent-reported shifts to hidden reference linear model derived from paper Fig.4, with structural consistency checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold slopes for E2g2 frequency shift vs density
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from paper Fig.4 - linear relationship with slopes 12, 18, 24, 30 THz/(e/atom) for AED, NTD, TD, ID respectively
hidden_assets.generation_method: manually extracted from paper figure; the reference solve.sh uses exact same slopes confirming agreement
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The slopes correspond to the reported trends and magnitude: shift at 0.01 e/atom is 0.12, 0.18, 0.24, 0.30 THz, consistent with Fig.4. No synthetic holdout needed.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the computed E2g2 phonon frequency shift for each (distribution, density) pair. The checker compares these shifts to reference values extracted from the paper's Figure 4 and also verifies monotonic ordering and relative magnitude across distributions.

output_contract.notes: The agent must compute shifts for at least 4 distinct densities per distribution. The hidden checker verifies: (a) frequency shift is positive and increases monotonically with density for each distribution; (b) at any given density the shift ordering is ID > TD > NTD > AED; (c) the magnitude falls within a tolerance band derived from Fig. 4 of the paper. No gold values or tolerances are disclosed here.
